faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: We answer our guests' most common questions so you arrive at La Palma y el Tucán with everything clear.

items.q: Where is the hotel? How do I get there?
items.a: Between Zipacón and Cachipay, Cundinamarca, about 90 minutes from Bogotá. Once your reservation is confirmed, we'll send you the directions.
Cabin accommodation with private bathroom, tub and outdoor shower. Breakfast. Guided coffee tour. Coffee tasting. Welcome drink. Cloud forest trails (3.3 km). Common areas.
Double (2 guests) with king or twin beds. Triple for up to 3 guests. Family for up to 4. All offering complete privacy and a connection with nature.

items.q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
items.a: Check-in from 3:00 PM. Check-out until 11:00 AM. You can arrive from 9:00 AM to enjoy the hotel.

items.q: Is there a restaurant at the hotel?
items.a: Yes, our own restaurant with a farm-to-table approach and fresh ingredients from our garden. Breakfast included, lunch and dinner optional.
Yes, we are pet friendly. Up to 2 pets per cabin, with a charge of 60,000 COP.

metadata.title: Coffee experiences near Bogotá · La Palma y El Tucán Hotel
metadata.description: Coffee tour, sensory tasting, birdwatching, hikes, meliponario, mariposario, yoga and massages on a regenerative coffee estate 90 minutes from Bogotá.

intro.body_1: Our coffee experiences near Bogotá turn your visit to La Palma y El Tucán Hotel into far more than a place to rest. Through them, we invite you to connect with the essence of what we do: cultivating, transforming and enjoying the finest coffee in a way that is sustainable and respectful of the environment.
intro.body_2: Enjoy two experiences included with your stay; if you'd rather visit for the day, you can also book the Day Tour.

tour_cafe.title: Coffee tour: our coffee experience near Bogotá
tour_cafe.body: Immerse yourself in the essence of our regenerative agriculture with our Coffee Tour. Along the way, you'll discover every stage of the coffee process: from the agroecological crops in our cloud forest to the tasting of a cup freshly prepared with care.

tour_grid.title: What will you find on our Coffee Tour?

items.label: Cultivation
items.detail: Walk through coffee plantations with different varieties and learn how our planting methods and sustainable management contribute to the health of the soil and the protection of biodiversity.

items.label: Fermentation & Drying
items.detail: Visit our Beneficiadero (wet mill), where we process coffee microlots highly prized on the international market. Explore the raised drying beds and the hand-sorting station for green coffee, essential to guaranteeing the quality of every bean.

items.label: Sensory Analysis
items.detail: Discover how this essential phase of the process ensures that each microlot preserves and fully expresses the essence of its origin and variety, delivering a unique flavor experience in every cup.

tour_grid.footer: And if you visit us during harvest season, you'll see up close the hand-picking of ripe cherries, the depulping, the sensory evaluations and all the «wonderful chaos» that surrounds this work. Every detail is tended to with the utmost care to preserve the quality of the coffee.

degustacion.title: Specialty Coffee Tasting
degustacion.body: Round out your coffee experiences near Bogotá with a sensory tasting:
numbered_list: Take part in a guided tasting where you'll learn to recognize the characteristics of a specialty coffee, identifying its flavor and aroma notes.
Delight your senses with different coffee profiles and pick up valuable tips for brewing a great cup at home.
degustacion.note: The specialty coffee tasting is included in your reservation.

experiencias_page.day_tour: If you'd like to visit us for the day, we invite you to book our Day Tour: a four-to-five-hour experience that combines the Coffee Tour, the Specialty Coffee Tasting and a full lunch at our hotel.

subsections.title: Birdwatching
subsections.body: A guided walk to explore our ecosystem and discover the rich diversity of bird species that inhabit it.

subsections.title: Nature walks: coffee experiences near Bogotá in the open air
subsections.body: Roam our region along country roads, trails and ancient paths. Discover rock art left by ancestral Indigenous communities and let yourself be dazzled by the landscape and local wildlife.

subsections.title: Visit to the Meliponario
subsections.body: Discover El Meliponario, a project led by members of the local community working to conserve native stingless bees and to protect the area's resources, flora and fauna. Experience getting to know more than 10 species of bees in their natural habitat, on a 2.5-hour tour that will make you fall in love with these wonderful pollinators.

subsections.title: Visit to the Mariposario
subsections.body: Discover El Mariposario, a project led by the local community working to conserve water and the plant species of the Cloud Forest. Encounter powerful medicinal plants and the main butterfly species of our forests on a 2.5-hour tour.

subsections.title: Relaxing Massage
subsections.body: Enjoy a massage with aromatic oils in the comfort of your own cabin.

subsections.title: Yoga
subsections.body: A Hatha Yoga class to connect with your body and mind and lift your energy. A gentle practice of postures and yoga on the mat.

metadata.title: Corporate events · La Palma y El Tucán Hotel
metadata.description: Private spaces for corporate gatherings, retreats and innovation sessions among coffee plantations and cloud forest, 90 minutes from Bogotá.

blocks.title: Connect, spark ideas and boost productivity
blocks.body: Our private, versatile spaces, paired with tailored menus and personalized service, are framed by the aroma of one of Colombia's most renowned coffees, grown with regenerative practices that care for the land and strengthen the future.

Our meeting and event spaces are designed to fuel creativity and collaboration. With abundant natural light, views of the coffee plantation and technology ready for high-impact gatherings, we offer a setting that brings together the best of the corporate world with the renewing power of nature.

Picture a workday surrounded by the calm of the cloud forest. Whether for a strategic gathering, a corporate retreat or innovation sessions, at La Palma y El Tucán you'll find a regenerative setting that inspires, strengthens teams and opens space for new ways to lead and create.
blocks.body_extra: Explore our accommodation options and discover a new way to find inspiration!

metadata.title: Accommodation · Boutique cabins at La Palma y El Tucán Hotel
metadata.description: 10 independent cabins surrounded by coffee plantations and cloud forest, 90 minutes from Bogotá. Double, triple and family options with tub, outdoor shower and private balcony.

intro.body: At La Palma y El Tucán Hotel you'll enjoy a stay with every comfort, surrounded by our coffee plantations and the enchanting cloud forest. We offer a range of accommodation options —double, triple and family cabins— designed to give you the warmth of home. All of our cabins come with the amenities you need to fully experience the biodiversity and serenity of the Colombian Andes.
